meta.title: NFHS-5 (2019-21) and NFHS-6 (2023-24) district fact sheet indicators, Odisha
meta.source: IIPS. National Family Health Survey (NFHS-6), 2023-24: State and District Fact Sheets, Odisha (published May 2026); IIPS and ICF. 2021. National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5), 2019-21: State and District Fact Sheets, Odisha. Mumbai: IIPS. Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.
meta.short: NFHS-5 (2019–21) and NFHS-6 (2023–24, published May 2026), IIPS and MoHFW
notes: Same figures as district-health.html. District names use the portal spellings.
Each district value is [NFHS-6, NFHS-5]; null where the fact sheet shows no figure.
polarity: 1 higher is better, -1 lower is better, 0 no clear better direction.
Neither round publishes a district total fertility rate.
